bluebirds.weighting: round(3*max(0,logit((training_correct+2)/(training_n+4)))) clipped to [0,10]; exact integer subset DP.
bluebirds.uncertainty: Conditional on trained policy and workers; image resampling only

cities.weighting: round(3*max(0,logit((training_correct+2)/(training_n+4)))) clipped to [0,10]; exact integer subset DP.
cities.uncertainty: Fixed test city-pairs; no confidence intervals
cities.split: Disjoint city identities: within-train-city pairs for training, within-test-city pairs for test; cross pairs excluded
